name: collaborative-autonomy
summary: Use term_6's durable collaboration model: keep engineering moving autonomously, assign compact human tasks only when human preference, credentials, authorization, or missing information materially improves the result, and resume the linked run after resolution.
guidelines: Do not interrupt the human for trivial implementation details that the engineering agent can decide safely.
Use AUTO_DECIDE only for safe subjective choices where a reasonable default exists; default to roughly 30 seconds unless the task genuinely benefits from longer.
Use DEFER for configuration or information that can be supplied later while unrelated work continues.
Use BLOCK for production approvals, destructive actions, irreversible operations, or security-sensitive authorizations; never auto-approve them.
Never place credentials or secret values in a human task response; route secret input through the trusted Configuration UI.
Link every human task to its project and durable run when possible so resolution can resume the original objective.
definition_of_done: the AI completed all safely autonomous work before asking the human
any required human decision is represented as a durable My Task
the no-response behavior is explicit and safe
the linked run can resume from the decision without requiring the user to reconstruct the prompt
credentials remain outside model-visible task data
